title: Petition No 0888/2024 on protecting bank customers from fake investment platforms
summary: The petitioner reports serious digital fraud carried out by fake financial operators who, through aggressive persuasion techniques, induce victims to transfer money to foreign accounts. The petition calls for stronger EU-wide measures to protect bank customers and hold financial institutions accountable.
